map.翼展 b=10 m、机翼面积 S=15 m²，展弦比 AR = b²/S = 1: Wingspan b=10 m and wing area S=15 m², so aspect ratio AR = b²/S = 100/15 ≈ 6.67. This value is at the lower end of the common transport range of 7-9, indicating a somewhat short, stubby wing with slightly higher induced drag but a lighter structure.
map.高展弦比和低展弦比各有什么利弊？: What are the pros and cons of high and low aspect ratio?
map.高展弦比（滑翔机可达 30+）诱导阻力小、巡航效率高，但结构长细比大、机翼重、不: A high aspect ratio (gliders can reach 30+) has low induced drag and high cruise efficiency, but a large structural slenderness, a heavy wing and unsuitability for high speed; a low aspect ratio (fighters 2-4) is structurally strong and suited to high-speed manoeuvring, but has high induced drag and a short range. Selection is a trade-off between cruise efficiency and manoeuvrability/speed.
